messages:
maria (Marketing): heads up — noticed ~12 inbound leads in the past hour that never hit a Sales owner. HubSpot shows property 'enrichment_status' = 'pending' and TTL > 30m. SLA breach for handoff.

sam (SalesOps): ugh. are they stuck before round-robin assign or after?

maria (Marketing): looks like enrichment pending blocks the workflow. our WS waits for 'enriched_profile' before triggering RR assignment. enrichment provider returning a lot of 504s.

lee (RevOps): can you drop the workflow id and a sample lead id? i'll take a look at logs.

maria (Marketing): workflow id: 5643. sample contact id: 0031f2a7. snippet from workflow:
```
- wait for property: 'enriched_profile' (timeout 1h)
- action: assign owner -> round_robin(team=SDR_INBOUND)
- action: if owner null -> set owner = 'unassigned_inbound' and create task
```

olivia (Growth): FYI we increased the wait timeout to 1 hour last week to reduce churn on the enrichment provider — looks like that backfired for handoffs. Recommend we revert to shorter wait and add faster fallback.

sam (SalesOps): agree. short-term mitigation: fallback to an owner after 5m and notify #sales-ops. long-term: fix RR lambda so it doesn't swallow errors. i saw an exception in logs: 
`Error: duplicate lock acquisition on key sdr_rr_2026` causing the assign to bail.

lee (RevOps): i'll update the HubSpot workflow to 5m wait + fallback to a default queue owner, and create an automation to requeue leads if enrichment eventually completes. doing it now.

maria (Marketing): thanks — i'll export the 12 stuck leads and requeue them via API after the workflow change. how should i requeue?

sam (SalesOps): requeue via PATCH to /crm/v3/objects/contacts/{id} setting property `requeue_assignment` = `true` — our RR lambda watches that flag and will attempt assign immediately. also add tag `requeued-manual`.

maria (Marketing): exporting CSV and running a quick script.

olivia (Growth): also, we should add a HubSpot-to-SF sync sanity check: if contact.owner is null > 10m then create task for SDR lead and ping Slack. reduces cold leads in SF.

sam (SalesOps): open PR for RR lambda fix (retry on 504, 3 attempts, exponential backoff) — PR: github.com/redwood/rr-lambda/pull/432. ETA EOD.

product-bot: New alert created: inbound.handoff.latency > 5m (1m window) -> page: oncall-salesops.

lee (RevOps): i updated workflow 5643: wait changed to 5m, fallback action added -> set `owner` = queue:SDR_INBOUND_FALLBACK + create task and send Slack message to #sales-ops. will also add property `enrichment_provider` to track which provider failed.

hubspot-bot: Workflow 5643 updated by lee at 2026-10-07T14:23:12Z.

maria (Marketing): requeued the 12 leads. 9 assigned immediately after RR retried, 3 still pending (provider throttled). monitoring dashboard.

olivia (Growth): great. can we update the inbound playbook? change recommended TTL from 1h -> 5m, add escalation steps, and include instructions to requeue via API + CSV sample.

sam (SalesOps): i'll draft the playbook update and link it here. quick checklist:
- HubSpot workflow wait -> 5m
- fallback owner -> SDR_INBOUND_FALLBACK
- RR lambda: retry on 5xx (3x) + backoff
- add alert inbound.handoff.latency >5m
- manual requeue script in ops repo

maria (Marketing): pinging @product and @engineering for visibility. :thumbsup:

lee (RevOps): i'll follow up with an audit tomorrow to catch any other workflows with long waits. we should also add metrics: percent of leads assigned within 5m, by enrichment provider.

maria (Marketing): thanks team — will report outcomes in next standup.
